FN-ARR4VS7-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 333
Committee: County and Municipal Sponsor: Representative David Faulkner
Government
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/03/2025
House Bill 333 as introduced would provide that: 1) two or municipalities may establish a
regional law enforcement training authority that is a governmental agency; 2) the authority is
exempt from all taxation; 3) the authority may sell or issue bonds that are the sole responsibility
of the authority; 4) the authority can acquire property, construct, and operate the training facility;
5) the authority can employ personnel to operate the training facility; and (6) participating
municipalities may lend or donate funds, donate, sell, lease, or grant property, or pay the
proceeds of any special tax appropriated, apportioned, or allocated to the authority.

FN-ARR4VS7-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 333
Committee: County and Municipal Sponsor: Representative David Faulkner
Government
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/05/2025
House Bill 333 as reported by the Committee on County and Municipal Government would
provide that: 1) two or municipalities may establish a regional law enforcement training
authority that is a governmental agency; 2) the authority is exempt from all state tax and from
taxes levied by any county, municipality, or other political subdivision of the state if adopted by
resolution or ordinance of the local governing body; 3) the authority may sell or issue bonds that
are the sole responsibility of the authority; 4) the authority can acquire property, construct, and
operate the training facility; 5) the authority can employ personnel to operate the training
facility; and (6) participating municipalities may lend or donate funds, donate, sell, lease, or
grant property, or pay the proceeds of any special tax appropriated, apportioned, or allocated to
the authority.
